question: The four P3 round-2 items of 25.09 merged on wf10/p3-round2 (signatures, thin-hanging, clear-distance, robustness) on top of wf7/p3 (f46a669), with the captain's delegate's decision A (health.clear_cap on, candidate R1): does the combined default config pass the full regression gate against regression_baseline_2026-09-25_ride_p3.json with every safety condition, and what is the new gate baseline?

preregistered.before_any_result: No gate, detector or stress run on the merged code yet. The merges were checked only with the unit tests (454 passed on the native path) and ruff.
preregistered.code: e136fcb = f46a669 (wf7/p3 merged, baseline _ride_p3) + --no-ff merges of wf9/signatures 468d346 (4c33541), wf9/thin-hanging d29a627 (ae69000), wf9/clear-distance c926b0e (19d2dd7), wf9/robustness 83c360a (e136fcb); all four branches from 1c96233, i.e. measured on their branches before wf7/p3. Measured on the first clean commit after this file that applies decision A (health.clear_cap true) and adds decision B's flag cluster.hanging_needs_rails (default false, byte-identical when false); native path
merged_code_interactions: resense/detector.py process(): wf7/p3's far_axis_both_sides mode-2 step (off) runs before the hanging stage 5b, which reads the verified range min(valid, floor_valid); with mode 2 off the order does not matter

resense/detector.py: the hanging clusters (kind 'hanging') join the cluster list the tracker, _far_both_sides (skips kind != '') and clear_cap read; a hanging cluster's distance is its nearest point (including the part above the envelope top), not wf7/p3's gauge_distance
resense/detector.py: robustness moved _frame_dt before _fit_track and passes periods (median of the last 9 sane stamp intervals / tracking.frame_dt) to estimate_track and the calibration; 1 at 10 Hz

resense/track.py estimate_track: the model age counts nominal periods (rates_per_period), so wf7/p3's floor-shadow warm-up (prev.age >= axis_warmup_frames) counts periods too; floor_hold_run (floor_shadow_max_hold) stays per processed frame like the bed / rail smoothing; walls_smoothing ** k for the yaw / curvature EMA; the axis rate limits x k
resense/health.py: clear_cap's candidate_distance next to wf7/p3's floor-shadow counters in the status dict (both additive)
resense/clustering.py: floating_free (signatures) inside _advisory_reason, independent of wf7/p3's _gauge_part / gauge_reach_mask
tests/test_late_candidates.py: wf9/signatures' floating_free_max_size=0 in the three cube examples merged cleanly with wf7/p3's added tests

the axis filter is chaotic: a tiny change of the track model (robustness at 10 Hz: keep_within_deg on doubleT_obstacle) can persist for hundreds of frames, so the combination may differ from the sum of the items on any recording

effective.unchanged from _ride_p3: track.floor_shadow_height 1.0, floor_shadow_max_hold 20, cluster.oversize_split_max_length 3.0, oversize_split_max_distance 30, gauge_distance true; walls_min_far_support 0, far_axis_both_sides 0, floor_far_min_width 0

preregistered.if_worse: A gated row worse because items interact: find the pair by re-running the gate (or the failing data set with scripts/eval_real.py) with each round-2 item's default turned off in turn with --set (signatures: cluster.floating_free_max_size=0; thin_hanging: cluster.hanging_enabled=false; robustness: the five flags false / 0; clear_cap cannot move a gated row), then turn off the default of the lesser item of the interacting pair (the one whose own gain is smaller on the safety rows; the safety rule decides), re-run the full gate on the new clean commit and record every run here.
preregistered.decision_B: cluster.hanging_needs_rails (the thin-hanging rail-lock guard) is pre-registered separately, as an addendum to p3_thin_hanging_2026-09-25.json, committed alone after this file: the same gate command with --set cluster.hanging_needs_rails=true on the same commit, compared with this run (--from-json <with> --baseline <this run>); adopted only under that addendum's rule, then the full gate re-runs on the commit that sets it
